novelty_flags.label: Theorem 1 (thm:zhu-risk-derivation)
novelty_flags.one_line: The p=1/2 factor 2^(m_ii'+1)1{m_ii'>0} and its residual-covariance contribution are already derived in Zhu et al., Appendix B.1, so this should be cited/imported background rather than a novel theorem target.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 1 (thm:zhu-risk-derivation)
soundness_flags.one_line: The fixed-potential-outcome setup defines neither Zhu et al.'s repeated outcome/covariate residual process nor a link from Sigma to it, so it cannot yet support the claim that V is their causal residual criterion rather than a separately defined algebraic score.

soundness_flags.label: ass:valid-tree-decomposition
soundness_flags.one_line: The stated cover/running-intersection condition is only an ordinary tree decomposition; it does not require the rooted leaf/introduce-vertex/introduce-edge/forget/join node forms used by def:dp-transitions.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published residual term is N^{-1} sum_{i,i'} [p^{-m_ii'}+(1-p)^{-m_ii'}] Sigma_ii' 1{m_ii'>0}; at p=1/2 this is the proposed 2^(m_ii'+1) factor.

A nice tree decomposition is rooted and has specified leaf, introduce-vertex, introduce-edge, forget, and join bags, with every edge introduced once; cover and running intersection alone do not establish those properties.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace Theorem 1 with an explicitly cited p=1/2 specialization of Zhu et al., or add the missing repeated-outcome residual model, conditional mean, and pilot construction if a standalone causal derivation is intended.

State ass:valid-tree-decomposition as a supplied rooted nice decomposition with all node-type and one-time edge-introduction requirements, or preprocess an ordinary decomposition and include that conversion in the runtime.
Strengthen the four-cycle separation to a parameterized nondegenerate C4 covariance family, with an explicit open interval of strict surrogate/full-risk reversals.
Add an implementation-facing comparison against Zhu's spectral surrogate and a certificate-size/runtime benchmark on sparse covariance-support instances.

recommended_next_step: Revise the causal-model bridge and nice-decomposition assumption, and demote the published Zhu algebra to cited background before advancing the exact-optimization kernel to Stage 0.
